sql: SELECT SUM(n.value) FROM sub s JOIN dnum n ON n.adsh = s.adsh JOIN dim d ON d.fact_id = n.fact_id WHERE s.name = 'MICROSOFT CORP' AND s.form = '10-K' AND s.period = 20260630 AND n.tag = 'OperatingIncomeLoss' AND n.ddate = 20260630 AND n.qtrs = 4 AND n.uom = 'USD' AND d.axis = 'BusinessSegments'  AND n.ndims = 1
